headline.text: L3 truffle line was down *7 hours* on wire mesh failure — back online by 11:42 after full replacement.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel cluster on Sollich 4 with jamming resolved by tunnel temp adjustment at 22:38. Sollich 4 kitchen ran out of caramel twice due to 55-minute cook times and steamer system faults — back cooking by 08:00. Third shift started KKL macadamia clusters on Sollich 3 with brief steam/caramel shortage, cleared by 07:52. Recurring salt spec issue flagged on one pallet sent to rework.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 started up for Hershey 8g truffles on third shift with chocolate push complete by 03:31. First shift deposited with caramel starting 09:31, paused briefly at 09:49 for clogged nozzles and at 11:02 for blade check — both cleared inside 20 minutes.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 molding line 1 ran 35g product with brief V1/V2 display mismatch, cleared by 10:20 when warehouse delivered correct version. Truffle line down from 02:08 to 11:42 on wire mesh failure — three breaks found, full mesh replaced, fuses replaced. ML4 changeover to Feastables consumed most of the window with mold jams, inclusion mixer faults, and depositor 4 heating issues — plain bars depositing by 08:32.

notes.text: Foreign material found on Sollich 3 — hard plastic fragment, possibly from tray edge, during KKL mac cluster run at 02:52.
During truffle line wire mesh replacement, maintenance found 1/2 inch chocolate buildup on return trough.
ML4 depositor 4 still showing tempering device faults at end of window; MLC was reset at 11:24.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Kitchen S3 steam issue causing caramel shortage
resolved.summary: Circuit overload tripped and kettle 1 lid not fully closed; 25 minutes of caramel remaining.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:52 — have caramel and line up and running (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 East-side lines jamming before cutter
resolved.summary: Two lines kept flopping over and jamming; pieces too tall due to tunnel temperature too low.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:38 — operator raised Tunnel 1 temperature and issue improved (William Beattie).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 Kitchen S4 steamer system not working
resolved.summary: Ran out of caramel twice due to 55-minute cook times, then steamer system failed during caustic clean; motor turning off and on.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 08:00 — QA passed carastar and kettler approved to begin cooking (Mary Montilla).

resolved.title: ML2 clogged nozzles at depositor
resolved.summary: Stopped depositing with caramel due to a few clogged nozzles.

resolved.title: ML2 line down for blade check
resolved.summary: Line down for maintenance to check the blades.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:06 — line back up (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML4 mold jams in pre-heating cabinet
resolved.summary: Bent rails in pre-heat cabinet causing mold jams during Feastables changeover.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:55 — mold jam fixed, aligned both sides rails, replaced bent rails (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: Truffle line wire mesh broken in enrober
resolved.summary: Wire mesh broken in 2-3 places during reheat; line down from 02:08, maintenance replaced individual wires then determined full mesh replacement needed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:42 — new wire mesh installed, fuses replaced on enrober, product at enrober (Rich Brierley).

resolved.title: ML4 heating cabinet evacuation chain position lost
resolved.summary: Heating cabinet evacuation conveyor lost zero and wouldn't jog manually during changeover to Feastables.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:06 — heating cabinet back in good position, ran 15 indexes properly (Shawn Jewkes).

resolved.title: ML4 inclusion mixer not running in auto
resolved.summary: Inclusion mixer (brabender) giving faults when trying to run in auto mode, blocking capture test.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:15 — inclusion system now working in auto, performing capture test; line lead started system as regular and everything worked (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML1 display version mismatch V1 vs V2
resolved.summary: Displays received were V1 but pallet label said V2; QA required V2, line had to stop until correct version found.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:20 — warehouse brought V2 displays, depositing chocolate again (Grey Boscan).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 recurring salt specification miss
needs_attention.summary: Pallet from third shift had very little salt per spec, going to rework to be sent to L3 for blending; Curt notes this is the second time this issue has occurred.
needs_attention.status: Pallet placed in rework status as of 09:06; Curt asked for corrective action plan at 10:51.
